name: Button
summary: Marketing call-to-action buttons for the landing sites. These FOLLOW the product Button contract (aha-button): primary, secondary and pink-accent variants at the DS default 8px radius (--aha-radius-default) and the large control height — the same shape and size as both the product Button and the current live marketing buttons, so the preview reads as the buttons the site ships today. Colour, size, radius and motion all bind to the DS Button tokens. On a product surface reuse <aha-button> itself; on a framework-free marketing page paste this anchor form. Uses the DS elevation token, the product component's soft box-shadow focus ring (--aha-button-focus-ring), and the secondary variant's hover text-colour and press-border states from aha-button.js.
html: Primary Secondary Pink
